title: Really a cooler bag; works well to keep my bananas fresh for a few days longer
text:
Really a cooler bag; works well to keep my bananas fresh for a few days longer. I was skeptical this would work and I didn't see the difference until I waited five days. These are really small cooler bags.

In the winter, I can keep my bananas fresh for over two weeks on a banana tree because I keep my house at 57 degrees Fahrenheit. However, in the summer I keep it at 72 degrees and they go bad within a week. Putting my bananas in this bag after day two helps stop the ripening process. I used a bunch of bananas and a few from the bunch I left out and the others I put in the cooler bag. I didn't notice a difference until day 5. See photos. The control bananas are on the left and the bagged ones are on the right. However, they only lasted to day 6 in the bag before they went bad.

In addition, these bags can be used as sort of cooler bags if needed. I've often used bags like these to carry ice cream with me in a cooler by putting the ice cream in something like this and then the entire bag in another cooler.

In summary, this is really a cooler bag. It works well to keep my bananas fresh for a couple of days longer and NOT two weeks. I do wish it came with instructions that says when the bananas should go in the bag. For instance, do I have to wait until the bananas fully ripen before inserting them in the bag? That is what I did but it was not clear when the bananas should be inserted. The current price of $12.90 is pricey for this as it comes to $6.45 per bag. For me it is not worth it because most of my bananas are gone within seven days. Also, I keep my house cool and in the winter at 57 degrees, I do not need such a bag because my bananas last over two weeks. I rated this 3 stars because they work somewhat but I would never buy such a product for my purposes especially for just for a few days more freshness.
